changes: Security update for the Android app: closed links other apps could open for no reason, and only trusted apps can now see or control what is playing.
Updated every part the app is built on, including the audio player, to current versions.
Fixed a white screen and a lost episode after pausing for a long time.
Episode artwork is sharp again on the player and the lock screen.
Long-press the app icon for Resume, New episodes, Queue and Explore.
Website: stronger protection for the server, and episode downloads no longer strain it.
Website: easier to find in search, and shared links now show a preview picture.
Website: works better with a keyboard and screen readers, and respects the reduce-motion setting.
Fixed shows that could stop getting new episodes.
Refresh in a show's menu now always loads the feed fresh.
The website handles very large feeds, up to 32 MB.
First release of the Android app and the web player.
Subscribe to any podcast feed, keep a queue, and download episodes for offline listening.
Playback speed, sleep timer, and import or export of your show list.
One account keeps your shows and your place in sync between phone and browser.
